run_pairwise_per_turn_eval: run the pairwise per turn evaluation crowdsourcing task using hydra config and mephisto
configure_per_turn_eval: configure the PerTurnEvalConfig dataclass with monitoring log rate and task directory defaults
register_per_turn_eval_script: register the perturnevalconfig script config with mephisto hydra for crowdsourcing task launch
run_task_with_config: run the crowdsourcing task by passing a hydra DictConfig and task directory to run_task
set_monitoring_log_rate: set the monitoring log rate in seconds for logging crowdsourcing task progress
